schedule.description: S3: Wild Card standings + Cardinals jab

stories.title: Game Recap — Imanaga Gems Cuba to WC1 With 6-1 Win at Miami
stories.angle: Imanaga gutted through 6+ innings, 1 ER, 3 H, 0 BB vs Janson Junk. Cubs won 6-1. M. Busch solo HR in the 9th. With the win, Cubs vaulted from WC2 to WC1 (80-62). Lead with Imanaga's line — not the final score.

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Imanaga was untouchable.

Six-plus innings, 1 run, 3 hits, zero walks. Cubs took the opener from Miami 6-1 — and vaulted into the NL's No. 1 Wild Card seed.

80-62. 20 games left. WC1.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Game Preview — Boyd vs Gusto, 3:10 PM CT
stories.angle: Matthew Boyd (8-3, 3.99 ERA) faces Marlins' Ryan Gusto (5.20 ERA season, hot in last 6 games). Cubs one win from series lead with home finale tomorrow. Stat-heavy preview.

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
Matthew Boyd (8-3, 3.99 ERA) takes the mound at 3:10 PM CT at loanDepot park.

He's opposed by Ryan Gusto, who's been hot lately despite a 5.20 ERA on the season.

One win today = Cubs hold WC1 going into the series finale tomorrow.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Wild Card Watch — Cubs Now WC1, Cardinals Fading
stories.angle: Cubs claim WC1 at 80-62. Cardinals at 71-71 — still chasing a wild card spot they have no realistic path to. Rival-jab format with standings snapshot.

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
NL Wild Card, September 5:

WC1: Cubs 80-62
WC2: Phillies
WC3: Diamondbacks

Cardinals: 71-71. Exactly .500, multiple games out of the final Wild Card spot.

St. Louis September. Same story, different year.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Chase — 39 HR / 32 SB With 20 Games Left
stories.angle: PCA sits at 39 HR / 32 SB. Needs 1 HR + 8 SB. No Cub has ever gone 40-40. Six times total in MLB history. 20 games on the schedule. This is achievable — and historic.

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong: 39 HR / 32 SB.

One home run. Eight stolen bases. Twenty games.

The 40-40 club has six members in MLB history. No Cub has ever done it.

PCA is knocking on the door.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: October Depth Building — Steele Rehab, Swanson On Track
stories.angle: Jed Hoyer confirmed Steele is back in AAA rehab and the best-case is a playoff bulk arm. Swanson resumed swinging, targeting a late-September return from his oblique strain. October roster keeps getting better.

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
Justin Steele is back in AAA rehab. Jed Hoyer's best case: a playoff bulk arm after 17 months away.

Dansby Swanson is swinging again — oblique strain on track — targeting a late-September return.

The October roster keeps getting better.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB
